title: DGX Spark - Host / Containers
description: CPU, unified memory, pressure, disk, network and containers.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: Load normalised by core count - 1.0 means fully committed.

panels.title: Unified memory used
panels.description: GB10 has no separate VRAM - this IS the GPU memory figure.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: High iowait with low user means the CPU is waiting on disk, not busy.

panels.title: CPU pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time some task was stalled waiting for CPU. A truer saturation signal than utilisation on a 20-core box.

panels.title: Memory - unified, so this is also the GPU's memory
